jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. jobs.title: Hands-on Engineering Manager (C#/Vue)
jobs.description: Location : 100% remote (EMEA + South America) Classification : Full-time Pay Range : €82,000–140,000; determined by several factors, including location Miaplaza is looking for two Engineering Managers to lead two of our software development teams. We’re hiring for one existing team of 7 engineers and one new team that we will hire developers into. This is a management role for someone who wants to grow as a manager while still remaining hands-on with code. You'll split your time roughly 50/50 between leading your team and doing hands-on work alongside them. About Miaplaza Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful! As an engineering manager at Miaplaza, your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Simulation (Digital Twins)
jobs.description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role You will be the first engineer on our Simulation team. Every site we map becomes a digital twin, built from our own lidar maps, and in it our robots see thousands of the intrusions, fires and sensor failures a real site sees once a year. Our multi-robot patrol policy was trained in simulation in under two hours on a single GPU and ran unmodified on real robots at three sites. Your job is to make that repeatable for every site and every new skill. You will work with our Skills & Orchestration engineers, who train learned skills with reinforcement learning, and with our Reliability & Test Infrastructure engineer, who runs regression in the same simulator. What You'll Work On Map to twin: a pipeline from our lidar maps to simulation-ready digital twins: geometry, semantics, materials, sensors.

jobs.description:
At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge?

As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly.

This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job.

Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices.

What You'll Work On

You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include:

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Auterion builds a cutting-edge operating system for autonomous robotic systems that empower a diverse range of platforms to perform surveillance, reconnaissance, inspection, mapping and logistics tasks. Our industry-leading software drives the adoption of robotic fleets and is recognized by the U.S. government as the future standard for its drone programs. 

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer taking on tasks within the AuterionOS ecosystem, from writing applications to adding driver support for new peripherals, maintaining system services and optimizing performance on embedded platforms. You will be working closely with:

  • Linux running on embedded hardware
  • C/C++, Python & Bash codebases
  • Engaged and friendly engineers from across Auterion

Responsibilities

  • Work within the Board Support team and collaborate with other development teams to build leading-edge products.
  • Add features, solve bugs, write tests and improve the performance of software components running on AuterionOS, Auterion’s custom embedded Linux distribution.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand both internal and customer use cases.
  • Propose new software solutions and take ownership of the implementation. Your technical expertise will have a huge impact on bringing Auterion’s drone products to market.
  • Provide expert support (L3) to customers

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. 

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges.
  • Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.
  • Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness consider

Les pièces de caisse en blanc sont en grande majorité réalisées à partir de tôles d’acier mises en forme, dont la conception repose encore largement sur l’expertise et sur des itérations successives entre calcul et dessin. L’optimisation topologique permet de déterminer la meilleure répartition de matière dans un domaine de conception donné. Appliquée à un domaine volumique 3D, elle conduit cependant à des structures massives ou de type treillis, difficilement transposables en pièces embouties d’épaisseur quasi constante. Le défi scientifique consiste à formuler une méthode capable de faire émerger, à partir d’un domaine volumique, des géométries représentatives de tôles (structures à parois minces), en maîtrisant l’épaisseur et la fabricabilité, sous chargements statiques puis dynamiques. Ce stage s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une collaboration de recherche entre le LTDS et ArcelorMittal Global R&D. Il a vocation à se poursuivre par une thèse CIFRE en cas de résultats concluants. L’objectif du stage sera de développer et d’évaluer une première méthodologie d’optimisation topologique 3D aboutissant à une solution en tôle d’acier, en s’appuyant sur une structure automobile. jobs.title: CDI - Senior AI Engineer - Paris
jobs.description:
Mission

De nouveaux modèles, ouverts ou fermés, sortent chaque mois : encore faut-il choisir ceux qui sont assez bons pour la production, et le démontrer. Applications et agents s’appuient sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM), et la partie modèle de ces systèmes est entre vos mains. Nos clients s’en servent pour répondre à leurs propres clients, traiter des documents et interroger leurs connaissances.

Ce que le modèle voit, la manière dont il retrouve les connaissances, les outils qu’il peut appeler : ces choix vous appartiennent, de même que la mesure de la qualité des réponses. Le modèle retenu doit tenir l’objectif de coût et de qualité.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez savoir si un système d’IA donne des réponses justes, et pas seulement s’il tourne.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype AI Engineer.

 

Activités et responsabilités

Les Product Engineers construisent l’application autour du modèle ; le comportement du modèle à l’intérieur vous revient. Les Context & Analytics Engineers préparent les connaissances que vos agents retrouvent, et les Platform Engineers exploitent le serving, le harness et l’observabilité

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Lead
jobs.description: Ben jij ready voor Change? Bij Change zoeken we een Talent acquisition Lead die recruitment naar een hoger niveau brengt. Je werft zelf actief mee en bent daarnaast de senior op de afdeling: je coacht junior recruiters, brengt structuur aan in de dagelijkse operatie en helpt het team groeien in eigenaarschap, kwaliteit en resultaat. Daarmee maak je meteen helder: dit is geen gewone recruiterrol, maar een combinatie van zelf doen, richting geven en mensen beter maken . Hier ga je werken: Bij Change kom je terecht in een energieke en snelgroeiende organisatie waar ontwikkeling, samenwerking en beweging centraal staan. We werken voor bekende merken zoals Marktplaats, Odido en Eneco en zorgen iedere dag voor de beste klantbeleving. Onze organisatie groeit hard en recruitment speelt daarin een belangrijke rol. We zoeken daarom iemand die zelf stevig in de werving staat, maar ook het recruitmentteam verder helpt ontwikkelen. Je werkt nauw samen met teamleads, management, HR en collega-recruiters. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid, ruimte om mee te denken en de kans om zichtbaar impact te maken op de groei van Change. Waar ben je verantwoordelijk voor? Actieve sourcing en hunting Je zoekt actief naar commercieel talent via LinkedIn, jobboards en netwerken. Je weet latent werkzoekenden te vinden en te enthousiasmeren voor Change. Coaching en ontwikkeling van het recruitmentteam Je begeleidt en coacht recruiters in sourcing, selectie, stakeholdermanagement en kandidaatcommunicatie.
